entries.detail: finops-peer-cohort/1.0.0, synthetic reference snapshot 2026-06-30. It contains no customer data and is not derived from, added to, or changed by a visitor's import.

Attributed org-unit count selects one inclusive size band; a declared supported industry selects the more specific industry-and-size cohort. The literacy score must use literacy-mix/1.0.0, and each metric needs at least 8 fixed cohort values.

Literacy score (higher is better), high-value share of scored prompts (higher is better), and recoverable share of observed USD (lower is better). Supporting metrics may be unavailable without suppressing a comparable literacy score.

Values are rounded to their declared precision before comparison. Percentile is the share strictly beaten plus half of ties, rounded to a whole number. Quartiles begin at the 25th, 50th, and 75th percentiles.

Comparability is close for industry plus size, broad for size only, or none. Confidence follows cohort specificity and member count. The single prioritized action is: close a bottom-quartile literacy gap; otherwise close a below-median recoverable-share gap; otherwise raise below-median high-value share; otherwise hold position.
